sql: CREATE TABLE t1(a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, b, c, d, e)

SELECT a, b+c FROM t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x, 5 FROM t2 JOIN t3 ON z=x WHERE x=2
  ORDER BY a

SELECT a, b+c+d FROM t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x, 5 FROM t2 JOIN t3 ON z=x WHERE x=2
  ORDER BY a

SELECT a, b+c+d+e FROM t1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x, 5 FROM t2 JOIN t3 ON z=x WHERE x=2
  ORDER BY a
